narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to document a day in the life of a busy mother living in Japan, highlighting her morning routine and how she maintains her skin health using Suntory Liftage collagen drink. It serves as an endorsement for the product, emphasizing its convenience, taste, and effectiveness for busy parents.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, close-ups of the packaging, drinking the product on camera, explaining its ingredients (PO-OG collagen, proteoglycan, Vitamin C), and providing a call-to-action for a discount.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively combines personal lifestyle content with a product review. The use of a toddler adds a layer of relatability for the target audience (mothers).
